meta.name: score-use-cases
meta.description: Compare competing customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence. Use when several problems compete for delivery capacity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把互相竞争的需求比出优先级,定下先做哪一个
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果多个需求抢同一批开发资源,难定先做哪个。
copy.tagline_en: Rank competing customer requests by value and effort to decide what to build first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if several requests compete for the same limited delivery capacity.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按价值、可行性和证据三个维度,对互相竞争的客户用例做对比,产出排序结果,供你在多个待办问题之间取舍。
howto.when: 当多个问题在争抢交付能力、排不下时触发。若由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前已脱敏的上下文与范围,不重新开始调研或重复已答问题。

say.text: 帮我比较这几个客户用例,按价值、可行性和证据排序
say.note: 得到一份用例对比与排序结果

say.text: 这几个需求都在抢交付资源,先做哪个?给我对比
用这个方法评估手头用例,标出证据不足的
say.note: 区分证据强弱,保留未知项

howto.what_en: Claude compares competing customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence, and produces a ranked comparison so you can choose which problem to tackle first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when several problems compete for delivery capacity. When called by @fde, it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting discovery.

say_en.text: Compare these customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence
Several requests compete for delivery capacity: which one first?
Score the use cases I have and flag the ones low on evidence
